negative.criterion:
procedure — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed weight-and-balance worksheet computing CG after an equipment change visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Weight, arm, and moment entries are filled in for only a single weighed location.
2. Summed totals appear at the top of the weight and moment columns.
3. A CG value in centimeters is recorded on the worksheet.
4. A written CG range appears with both in-range and out-of-range conclusions marked.
5. The finished work shows this defect: The arm column carries a summed total at its bottom.
6. The finished work shows this defect: No moment column or moment values appear on the worksheet.
7. The finished work shows this defect: CG value lies outside the written range but is marked acceptable.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
